OUR STORY

30 years of global connections, brought to your table

Sugar & Saffron is built on three decades of retail and wholesale experience — sourcing, importing and supplying authentic foods across borders for restaurants, grocers and distributors alike.

We're committed to bringing traditions, recipes and products from all around the world — from handmade kebabs and samosas to time-honored mithai and namkeen — made with the same care our family has used for generations, and packed for wherever your business needs them.
